Bug_Title: UR: Uninitialized read of field method called from constructor of superclass (UR_UNINIT_READ_CALLED_FROM_SUPER_CONSTRUCTOR)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by invoking the getValue() method from the superclass constructor in class A before the field 'value' in class B is initialized. This results in an uninitialized read of 'value' when getValue() is called.
Trigger_Explanation: The test method testShowBug creates an instance of class B, which in turn calls the constructor of superclass A. In the superclass constructor, the method getValue() is invoked, accessing the uninitialized field 'value' in B, which triggers the uninitialized read of the field.
